Twenty-five texture files, every one of them shown below over a transparency checkerboard, with our copy beside the donor's original. You said you didn't trust the claim. Here is what the claim was, whether it was true, and what it looks like now.

The claim was true — and it is already fixed

no magenta found

The four families really were broken, and the repair landed on 19–20 August in commit 3b724427 — before you asked to see it. So there is no magenta left to photograph. What this sheet can still prove is the two things underneath your doubt: that the paths genuinely could not resolve, and that what replaced them is the donor's own art, not a substitute.

Why the old paths could not have worked. Before the fix the defs pointed at bare paths like OuterRim/Genes/Headbone/ChagrianF. RimWorld resolves a texPath across every active mod, so a bare path is fine as long as somebody active ships it. Nobody did.

The two mods that own those texture roots — Neronix17.OuterRim.GalacticDiversity and guy762.StarWarsXenotypes — are both switched OFF in the live mod list. Our own races mod is on, and it ships only a RimMandrakeSW/ tree. With no active provider, the path resolved to nothing, and nothing is what magenta means.

And it would still have failed even with the donor switched on. Galactic Diversity's LoadFolders.xml maps 1.6 to / + Common + 1.6. Its loose PNGs live in Common_Old, which 1.6 does not load at all — on 1.6 it serves that art from an AssetBundle instead. The loose files below are readable for this sheet; they are not what the game would have read.

Two corrections to the original claim

What the claim saidWhat is actually there
“16 × OuterRim/GeneIcons/*BG” — read as sixteen icon files Two files, referenced sixteen times. EndogeneBG and XenogeneBG, eight gene defs each. There were never sixteen icons to lose, so the count overstated the damage by a factor of eight.
“mask_*” — an open-ended set Exactly three masks — mask_KotOR2, mask_Zuckuss, mask_yuun — plus a separate inventory icon, gand_mask_item, which is a different kind of thing and is shown apart below.

What this sheet cannot tell you

A file on disk is not a pawn on screen. Everything above is read from PNG files. It proves the art exists at the path the defs now name, and that it matches the donor. It does not prove the game draws it — that needs a load, and the four faces to look at are Nikolaus the Gand, a Selkath, a female Chagrian, and a Jawa in the yuun mask.

Gendered fields make this look intermittent. Male Chagrians always rendered; only the female field was broken. Testing one sex and calling the species clean is how this got missed the first time.

Absence of magenta is not proof of health. A Graphic_Multi with a bare path falls back rather than going magenta, so a broken path can quietly draw the wrong art instead of an obvious error. That is why every cell here is checked against the donor's pixels rather than merely checked for being non-magenta.
